reviewer_comment: 5-2(2): abstention rule for visual k-NN; risk, accuracy and CIs at matched coverage
protocol_status: time-stamped prospectively specified analysis plan, fixed after the reviewer's request and before this re-analysis; NOT a pre-registration filed before the study began

pipeline.threshold_provenance: fixed a priori on the EUS calibration half (Limitation 6)

R1_primary_matched_coverage.threshold_provenance: quantile of the D2-final visual-margin distribution reproducing the pipeline coverage; margins only, no labels (transductive)

comparator.threshold_provenance: split conformal: quantile on a seed-42 calibration half of D2-final, evaluated on the disjoint complementary half

pipeline_same_half.threshold_provenance: pipeline evaluated on the same conformal test half

R3_locked_threshold_d1_loo.threshold_provenance: locked: quantile of the D1 gallery leave-one-out visual-margin distribution (development-only, disjoint from D2-final); not retuned

paired_bootstrap_R1_vs_pipeline.resampling_unit: sample (with replacement); threshold re-derived within each resample
paired_bootstrap_R1_vs_pipeline.interpretation: Delta risk < 0 means the deferring visual k-NN has LOWER selective risk than the pipeline at matched coverage
